ai_overview_columns.note: Recorded exactly as returned 2026-11-24. Sydney and New York returned no AI Overview. This is the column spec to mirror.
melbourne: Household ID: Group couples, families, or plus-ones together (e.g., H01)
First Name & Last Name: Keep separate so you can sort alphabetically
Side / Group: Bride, Groom, Mutual, or Family/Friends
Priority Tier: A-List (must-haves), B-List (if space/budget opens), or C-List (other events)
Address, Email & Phone: Split street, city, state/postcode, and country for easy mailing
Envelope Name: Exact wording for invitations (fill on the first row per household)
Events Invited: Ceremony, Reception, Rehearsal Dinner, etc.
Save-the-Date & Invite Status: Not Sent, Sent, Declined
Meal & Dietary Notes: Meal choice, allergies, accessibility needs, or child status
Table Assignment: Seating chart table number
Gift & Thank-You: Gift received and thank-you card sent
dubai: First Name & Last Name: Keep these in separate columns for easy sorting and mail merges.
Household / Party: Group couples, families, or plus-ones under a shared label.
Envelope Name: Format the exact name to print on the invitation.
Side / Group: Note who invited the guest (e.g., Partner A, Partner B, Mutual) and their circle (e.g., family, college friends, coworkers).
List Tier: Track A-list vs. B-list guests if sending invitations in waves.
Email & Phone: Keep digital contact info handy for reminders or updates.
Mailing Address: Split into Street, City, State/Region, Postal Code, and Country for clean address labels.
Event Assignments: Add a column for each event (e.g., Welcome Dinner, Ceremony, Reception).
Save-the-Date & Invite Status: Track sent dates or Yes / No status.
RSVP Status: Track Yes, No, or Pending.
Meal & Dietary Notes: Record entrée choices, allergies, or accessibility needs.
Table Assignment: Assign seats or tables once RSVPs come in.
Gift & Thank-You Status: Log gifts received and check off thank-you notes.
ai_overview_columns.shared_rule: One row per person (guest), grouped by a household column. Our live page uses one row per household: switch to one row per person with a Household ID.
recommended_sheet_columns: Events invited (one column per event: welcome dinner, ceremony, reception, recovery brunch)

Destination extras: travelling from (city, country), flights booked, arrival date, departure date, accommodation (where staying), room block yes/no, transfer needed, visa letter needed, passport name as printed [[VERIFY: whether passport name is needed; only if the visa letter process asks for it]]

text: The guest list manager keeps every invitee in one place — organised by category, with RSVP status, meal preferences, dietary notes and travel details.
You can invite guests by email, let them self-register, and import or export the whole list as a CSV.
When to use it. As soon as you have a venue capacity in mind. Every later decision — seating, menu, budget — leans on this list.
